For purposes of the condition that a plan sponsor may not offer any employee a choice between an individual coverage HRA and a traditional group health plan, under the proposed rules, the term “traditional group health plan” was defined as any group health plan other than: (1) An account-based group health plan, or (2) a group health plan that consists solely of excepted benefits.
